Here's a photo from Beechwood State Park on Lake Ontario in New York. It was used as a Girl Scout camp until the late 1990s. Do these shelters look anything like the gazebo-like structures you're thinking of?

Helpful notification on this cold January night: MN State Park campsite reservations are now available through the weekend of May 9th. Just scored a site at Temperance River literally on Lake Superior. I assure you early May is not too early for North Shore camping.
Axial SCX10 III Base Camp V2 out on the breakwall at a new park I found along the shore of Lake Michigan

Well, it wouldn't be appropriate to erect his Big Blue Tent With Room For Everyone in Belle Park and there's No Camping Allowed in Lake Ontario Park so a private campground where poors & pedestrians would find it difficult to attend seems to compliment his Big Blue Tent With Room For "Everyone."

FJ McLain State Park This is a great campground in the upper peninsula of Michigan. The night sky is amazing. If you’re looking to be on the Lake Superior side campsite 72-77 are great!! by outbackhiker

You can! Depends where of course but you can camp in the Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore (or another campsite - Grand Marais just down the road has a nice path right down to the water and also public road access) and enjoy the view all night. Believe the Lakeshore itself is 24/7 access too. ❤️💧

I usually go up to the Muskegon State Park campground. It’s a nice location, right on Lake Michigan and only about an hour away from my house. 😁 I might branch out next year, though; I’ve heard of a couple other places that look interesting.

Hey Michigan pals, I’m trying to remember the name of a camping location by Lake Michigan that you need to hike into. Maybe halfway up the coast? Cannot for the life of me find it in this era of enshittified search.

Wisconsin State Parks continue taking Ls. 3 nights camping for "out of state" parties (tent site) is...#138!!! Meanwhile ANYONE can get a site a Temperance River state park literally looking at Lake Superior, for $80.

We’re at a cabin at Mackinaw Mill Creek Campground in Mackinaw City, MI. Along the Lake Superior coast they have benches, swings, and kettle shaped fire pits for all to enjoy. It’s quite spectacular and affordable.😊

There's no camping on site -- just wilderness and trails. But those trails lead to beautiful beaches on Lake Michigan, and at night, incredible views of the stars. Go on a virtual visit to Newport State Park in Door County:

🗺️🅿️ Travel/Parking: We will park in the Camp Beechwood East Entrance lot off of County Rd. 101 (Great Lakes Seaway Trl.), between Maxwell Rd./Gates Dr. and Buck Ln./Halcus Rd. ⛰️♿️ Accessibility/Difficulty: The trails are rated as easy difficulty level.

Zempire pro TM – Ludington/Lake Michigan First time out with the zempire. We added the screen porch door and removed the blackout bedroom. Removing the bedroom really opens up the tent nicely. Easy to set up. The air …

2️⃣ Sunset Bay RV Park and Resort - They have just over 20 partial hookup sites and 11 tent sites. It's small but it's right on the banks of the Great Lakes! Look at these views and the sites right on the water!
